description: Search live education jobs on EduAtlas: teaching and leadership posts at schools worldwide, support roles (marked), and posts at universities and education organisations. Free text works: "physics teacher London", "IB maths Dubai", "SENCO", "Lehrperson Zürich". The word "IB" limits results to IB World Schools. Filters (the same as eduatlas.org/jobs): school_type (state, independent, prep, international, ib), employer (school, university, organisation — the last for roles beyond the classroom, with kind_of_work), and post (teaching, primary, secondary, leadership, support for teaching assistants and pupil support, operations for office, IT, site and catering). Returns up to 20 jobs with school, location, salary where published, closing date and the EduAtlas job URL.

country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. gb, ie, ae, sg.

employer.description: Optional: only posts at schools, at universities, or at education organisations (publishers, exam boards, education charities, edtech, research bodies, tutoring companies, school groups' head offices). Use organisation for "jobs at publishers / exam boards / edtech" and for teachers looking beyond the classroom.

kind_of_work.description: Optional, with employer organisation: the kind of work — curriculum and content, teacher training and coaching, assessment and examining, research and policy, school partnerships and customer success, programmes and outreach, tutoring.

post.description: Optional: the kind of post — teaching, primary teaching, secondary teaching, school leadership, support (teaching assistants, SEN and learning support, early years, pastoral), operations (office, finance, IT, site, catering), or all.

query.description: Free-text search: subject, role and place words, plus "IB" to limit to IB World Schools.

school_type.description: Optional: only posts at this kind of school — state, independent (fee-paying senior and all-through schools), prep (independent primary: prep, pre-prep and junior schools, and primary posts at independent schools — kept apart from independent), international, or IB World Schools. The same filters as eduatlas.org/jobs.
